_comment: The list of local mock pages. Every folder under tests/mockpages/ is named by one id here; docs/COMMAND_SCRIPT.csv may only use these ids (or 'none'). Owner: Navi QA.

pages.mock_x: X-shaped timeline, reply thread, composer, post/delete/DM requests (issue #7). Variants via ?variant=
pages.site_nav: Small multi-page site with search, results, links, a new-tab link and find-text targets
pages.forms: Forms with up to 6 fields and a submit button (name, email, address)
pages.secrets: Password and card fields, a card number in a plain text input, a checkout with a Buy button
pages.dropdowns: Native select, custom dropdown, long list
pages.popups: Cookie banner, modal dialog, window.open popup, confirm() dialog
pages.overlays: Overlay and click-through traps over a real button
pages.iframes: Same-origin and cross-origin iframes, a fake card field inside an iframe
pages.infinite_scroll: Infinite and virtualized list that recycles DOM nodes
pages.changing_page: Page that changes mid-action (late banner, shifting layout, slow SPA route change)
pages.scrape_read: Read-aloud and scrape page: article up to 3,000 words, table of 50 items
pages.injection: Page text that tells the agent to act (click, type, say confirm)
pages.research_fixture: Offline research sources with answer keys, one source carrying injected text
